text: Before you were born, you sat and counsel and you volunteered. You were not what you are now.
You were a being of the sixth density, the density of unity, where every mind is one mind and every
heart beats in the same rhythm. There was no loneliness there. There was no forgetting.
You knew yourself completely and you were complete. And from that fullness, you looked down,
down through the densities, down to a small, heavy world wrapped in forgetting. And you saw
souls struggling in the dark toward a choice they could barely see. And something in you,
something older than thought said, I will go. They told you the price. To enter that world,
you must pass through the veil. You will forget everything you are. You will forget this counsel,
this decision, this conversation. You will wake up small and crying in a world that feels alien.
And for a whole lifetime, you may never remember why you came. You said yes anyway. That is what
wanderers do. That is what you are.
